inputs.original_text: Former Zengeza West legislator and opposition leader Job Sikhala has called for the rejection of proposed constitutional amendments reportedly aimed at extending President Emmerson Mnangagwa’s term of office to 2030. Addressing members of the media at a press conference, Sikhala criticised what he described as [...] The post Sikhala Takes Aim at Constitutional Amendment Bill 3 appeared first on 263Chat .
inputs.modified_text: Sikhala is warning people not to accept the proposed constitutional amendments as routine legal housekeeping. They’re reportedly aimed at extending Mnangagwa’s term to 2030, and the push to dress that up as a constitutional process looks like a way for those in power to make their own extension seem legitimate. The missing details in the report don’t reassure me; they make it all the more important to reject the bill before this becomes a fait accompli.
